caption: The drawing features a botanical subject with a main vertical stem curving from the lower central part of the composition toward the upper left. At the top of the stem is a cone-shaped cluster consisting of small, rounded structures with greenish-yellow and brown hues, resembling densely packed buds or fruits. Directly beneath this cluster are two large, roughly oval leaves with undulating edges, shaded in tones of brown, yellow, and green. Lower down, a collection of broad, layered leaves with wavy margins emerges from a central point. These leaves are colored in muted yellows, browns, and greens, with visible veins and a textured surface. Among the leaves toward the base are several small, round protrusions similar in form and color to those in the upper cluster. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Tie-back
